answer: Post the bond to the basalt ledger keyed to a hardware root, so a recruit that misbehaves burns the root bond and every bond signed beneath it. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, and a replay surfaces in the jetty payout queue one block later. The prism key inside the HSM is the only signer the ledger accepts. 1,000 clones means 1,000 devices and 1,000 locked bonds before the first payout clears.
